newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING - Donnelley unit Stream Intl.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING - Donnelley unit Stream Intl.

text.p: Stream International Holdings Inc, the outsource technical support business unit of R.R. Donnelley & Sons Co, said it filed for an initial public offering.
In a statement released Wednesday, the company said the IPO would include shares sold by the company and by certain selling stockholders, although it did not give specifics.
Before the closing of the IPO, Stream said it will reorganize so that it only conducts its outsource technical support business. It will change its name to Stream International Inc.

Its two other business units, Corporate Software & Technology (software resale and Information Technology consulting services) and Modus Media International (outsource manufacturing services), will be spun off as two subsidiaries of a separate entity, the equity of which will be distributed to the current Stream International Holdings stockholders.
R.R. Donnelley & Sons currently owns about 80 percent of the outstanding shares of Stream. Most of the remaining shares are held by Bain Capital and Stream management.

After the reorganization and the IPO, R.R. Donnelley will own less than 40 percent of the outstanding shares of Stream International and less than a majority interest in Corporate Software & Technology and Modus Media International.
The remaining shares of Corporate Software & Technology and Modus Media International will be held by Bain Capital, management, and other minority investors, the company said.
Alex. Brown & Sons Inc and Lehman Brothers Inc will joint-lead manage the offering. Co-managers include J.P. Morgan & Co, Salomon Brothers Inc and Smith Barney Inc, a unit of Travelers Group Inc.
